extraction.title: In odds we trust
extraction.subtitle: How Kalshi can help the Federal Reserve Prediction markets may be a win for central banking
extraction.summary: Kalshi's prediction markets are gaining attention from the Federal Reserve as a potential tool for real-time economic forecasting, outperforming traditional methods in accuracy for interest rate predictions and other economic indicators.
